snippet.title: Pixel Washer - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Pixel Washer, a cozy top-down pixel-based power washing game developed by Valadria. Players will embody a cute piggy power-washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash dirty sprites, upgrade your power washer, and clean up this filthy town. Pixel Washer is coming soon to PC (Steam).
